paite: Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim in vaihawm apat tung in hiai thu TOUPA kiang a kipan ahong tung hi:
heading: Jeremiah Vau A Omna
english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, came this word from Yahweh, saying,

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "TOUPA' inn huangsung ah dingh inla, Judah khopi tengteng Pathian be ding a TOUPA' inn a hong paite kiang ah akiang ua gen ding a thu ka hon piak tengteng khat lel leng iim lou in gen vek in.
english: Thus says Yahweh: Stand in the court of Yahweh’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in Yahweh’s house, all the words that I command you to speak to them; don’t diminish a word.

paite: Michih in a-omdan gilou uh paisan in angaikhe zenzen khamoh ding uhia, athilhih gilou uh ziak a atung ua thil hoih lou hih ka tup ka khektheihna ding in."
english: It may be they will listen, and turn every man from his evil way; that I may repent me of the evil which I purpose to do to them because of the evil of their doings.

paite: Nang akiang uah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Na hon ngaihkhiak louh ua, ka dan na ma ua ka koih na zuih louh ua,
english: You shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh: If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,

paite: zingsangpi a thou a amau na kiang ua ka sawl ka nasemmi zawlnei thu na limsak kei uleh;
english: to listen to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I send to you, even rising up early and sending them, but you have not listened;

paite: hiai inn Shiloh bang in ka bawl ding a, leitung a nam tengtengte hamsia thuak ding in ka bawl ding," na chi ding hi.
english: then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.

paite: Huan siampute, zawlneite leh mipi tengteng in TOUPA' inn a Jeremiah in hiai thu agen angaikhia uhi.
english: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, mipi tengteng kiang a gen ding a TOUPA'N apiak teng agen khit in, siampute, zawlneite leh mipi tengteng in amah amanta ua, "Si peuhmah niteh!"
english: It happened, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that Yahweh had commanded him to speak to all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people laid hold on him, saying, You shall surely die.

paite: Bangziak a TOUPA min lou a, "Hiai inn Shiloh bang ahi ding, hiai khopi luahmi om lou in asegawp ding, chi a gen na hia?" achi ua, Huchi in TOUPA' inn a mipi tengteng in Jeremiah aboh lutlut uhi.
english: Why have you prophesied in the name of Yahweh, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate, without inhabitant? All the people were gathered to Jeremiah in the house of Yahweh.

paite: Judah heutute'n hiai thu azak un, kumpipa' inn a kipan in TOUPA' inn lutna TOUPA' inn Kongpi Thak ah atu uhi.
english: When the princes of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house to the house of Yahweh; and they sat in the entry of the new gate of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchi in siampute leh zawlneite'n heutute leh mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Hiai mi si tak ahi, khopi siat ding thu, na bil ua na zak bang un agenkhol ngal a," achi uhi.
english: Then spoke the priests and the prophets to the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy of death; for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.

paite: Huan heutute leh mipi tengteng kiang ah Jeremiah in, "Na thu ngaihkhiak khitsate uh bang in hiai inn leh hiai khopi siat ding thu gen ding in TOUPA'N kei hon sawl ahi.
english: Then spoke Jeremiah to all the princes and to all the people, saying, Yahweh sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in na omdan uleh na gamtatdan uh bawlhoih unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh thu mang un; huchi in TOUPA'N na tung ua thil hoih lou tung ding aphuankhiaksa akikhelsak thei ding hi.
english: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of Yahweh your God; and Yahweh will repent him of the evil that he has pronounced against you.

paite: Kei ka hihleh, na khut ua om ka hi. Dik leh hoih na chih bang un hon bawl un.
english: But as for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as is good and right in your eyes.

paite: Na hon thah uleh, noumau leh hiai khopi leh khua-le-tuite tung ah mihoih sisan na tungsak ding uh chih thei mai un; adiktak in na bil ua hiai thute gen dia TOUPA'N na kiang ua hon sawl ka hi," achi hi.
english: Only know for certain that, if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, and on this city, and on its inhabitants; for of a truth Yahweh has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.

paite: Huchi in heutute leh mipite'n, siampute leh zawlneite kiang ah, "Hiai mi asih ding ahi kei, TOUPA i Pathian min a i kiang ua thu gen ahi,” achi uhi.
english: Then the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets: This man is not worthy of death; for he has spoken to us in the name of Yahweh our God.

paite: Huan huai gam Upa kuate hiam ahong dingh ua, mipi omkhawmte kiang ah,
english: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,

paite: "Mikah, Moreseth mi'n Judah kumpipa Hezekiah vaihawm lai in thu agen a, Judah mi tengteng kiang ah, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Lou bang in Zion leh ahi ding a, Jerusalem thil se omkhawm asuak ding, tang a inn gammang mun sang bang ahi ding," achi hi.
english: Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus says Yahweh of Armies: Zion shall be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.

paite: Judah kumpipa Hezekiah leh Judahte tengteng in amah athat uhia? TOUPA lau in TOUPA deihsakna angen ua, TOUPA'N atung ua thil hoih lou tung ding apuan akikhelsak ahi kei maw? E'n zaw i tung ua thil hoih lou tungsak ding i hi ve ua! achi hi.
english: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Didn’t he fear Yahweh, and entreat the favor of Yahweh, and Yahweh relented of the disaster which he had pronounced against them? Thus should we commit great evil against our own souls.

paite: Huan midang, TOUPA min a thugen Keriath-jearim mi Shemaiah tapa Uriah mah leng a-om a, Jeremiah thugen tengteng mah bang in hiai gam leh khopi siat ding thu agen hi.
english: There was also a man who prophesied in the name of Yahweh, Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath Jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:

paite: Kumpipa Jehoiakim leh amithupite leh heutute'n azak un kumpipa'n hihlup atum a; himahleh Uriah in azak in alau a, ataimang a, Aigupta gam ah apaita hi.
english: and when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death; but when Uriah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt:

paite: Kumpipa Jehoiakim in Akbor tapa Elnathan leh midangte toh Aigupta gam ah mi asawl hi.
english: and Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him, into Egypt;

paite: Huchi in Aigupta gam a kipan in Uriah apikhia ua, kumpipa Jehoiakim kiang ah ahon pi ua, huai in namsau in athat a, aluang vantang han ah apailut ua, achi uhi.
english: and they fetched forth Uriah out of Egypt, and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

paite: Himahleh Shaphan tapa Ahikam in Jeremiah agum a, huchi in hihlup ding in mipite kiang ah piak ahita kei hi.
english: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
